data.title: 因幡巡 · 晨光微熹的宽松白衬衫
data.description: 清晨温暖阳光漫过原木餐桌，巡只穿着一件宽松微长、质地柔软的落肩白衬衫，修长白皙的双腿轻快晃动。她双手握着冒着热气的咖啡马克杯，微翘的嘴角带着狡黠又甜美的浅笑，微风吹起薄薄的衣角，散发着居家的纯美诱惑。
data.location: sunny dining kitchen corner beside breakfast counter
data.action: 她双手握着冒着热气的咖啡马克杯，微翘的嘴角带着狡黠又甜美的浅笑，微风吹起薄薄的衣角
data.lighting: bright cheerful sunbeams streaming through kitchen balcony glass
data.promptProse: In a sunlit timber-toned kitchen at breakfast time, Meguru perches lightly on a wooden stool cradling a steaming coffee mug with both hands and flashing a bright, teasing smile as morning rays cross the table.
data.animaCaption: Perched on a wooden kitchen stool in warm morning sunbeams holding a steaming coffee mug in both hands, she wears only an oversized white boyfriend shirt slipping off one bare shoulder above her swinging bare legs with a playful morning smile.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a loose oversized white cotton shirt slipping casually off one shoulder to reveal her collarbone and bare thighs, its soft hem catching the morning breeze.
